column1: Write a Go function that sorts a slice of integers in ASCENDING order using the sort package. Show the function signature and a usage example with a sample slice.
Write a Go function that sorts a slice of integers in DESCENDING order using the sort package. Show the function signature and a usage example with a sample slice.
Explain how L1 cache (exact hash match) works in a semantic caching system: what is stored, how lookup works, and when it returns a hit. Be specific about the hash computation.
Explain how L2 cache (cosine similarity search) works in a semantic caching system: what is stored, how lookup works, and when it returns a hit. Be specific about the similarity threshold.
Implement a Go HTTP handler for POST /users that registers a new user. The handler reads a JSON body with name and email fields, validates them, and responds with 201 Created.
Implement a Go HTTP handler for GET /users that lists all registered users. The handler reads pagination parameters (limit, offset) from query string and responds with a JSON array.
Write a Go function that finds the minimum value in a slice of integers using a linear scan. Return the minimum and its index. Handle the empty slice case.
Write a Go function that finds the maximum value in a slice of integers using a linear scan. Return the maximum and its index. Handle the empty slice case.
Fix a data race in a Go Counter struct where Increment() adds 1 to the counter using c.value++ without a mutex. Add sync.Mutex to make it safe for concurrent access.
Fix a data race in a Go Counter struct where Decrement() subtracts 1 from the counter using c.value-- without a mutex. Add sync.Mutex to make it safe for concurrent access.
Implement an LRU cache in Go: a fixed-capacity cache that evicts the least recently used entry when full. Use a doubly linked list and a map. Show Set and Get methods.
Implement an LFU cache in Go: a fixed-capacity cache that evicts the least frequently used entry when full. Track access counts per key. Show Set and Get methods.
Write a Go function that encodes a string to Base64 using the standard encoding. Return the encoded string and any error.
Write a Go function that decodes a Base64 string back to the original bytes using the standard encoding. Return the decoded bytes and any error.
Write a recursive Go function to compute the nth Fibonacci number. Include memoization using a map to avoid redundant computation.
Write a recursive Go function to compute the nth Tribonacci number (each term is the sum of the three preceding terms). Include memoization using a map.
